0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Trail Blazers hosting the Suns. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe, who is out with a knee injury and has had surgery, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out with a shoulder injury and has also had surgery. In the 2025-26 season series, the Trail Blazers lost 1-2, but they won the most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Portland a 60% chance to win.
